data: Which of the following arrows show the flow of information from the "Context Network" to the word embeddings?

The arrows that show the flow of information from the "Context Network" to the word embeddings are the ones that connect the output of the Context Network to the word embeddings. In this case, there are three such arrows, one for each word embedding. These arrows are shown in blue and are located at the top right of the figure. Therefore, the correct answer is:

The arrows connecting the output of the Context Network to the word embeddings.
